attendance.note: Organiser-reported '2800++ pengunjung' (2,800+ visitors) over three days, 8 to 10 May 2026, with 43 exhibitors and 65 partners. The Display recap gives 'more than 2,500'.

ticket_price.note: Paid daily pass sold via linktr.ee/YKABF (organiser Instagram); under-5s free. Price not in captions; one visitor report puts entry at IDR 35,000. The free 'Road to YKABF' pre-event ran in April 2026.
